questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析及语境理解。作者回忆在乌干达西部的童年，提到生活充满了“和平与自由(peace and freedom)”，与后文难民营中“尘土飞扬、疲惫不堪”的复杂艰难生活形成鲜明对比，因此童年生活是“简单的、纯朴的(simple)”。balanced(平衡的)、creative(有创造力的)、harmonious(和谐的)虽为褒义，但simple最能与后文的沉重与反差相呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(balanced): 语境句：A balanced diet is essential for your healthy physical development. 固定搭配：balanced diet, keep balanced
B(creative): 语境句：The teacher encouraged the students to think in a creative way. 固定搭配：creative thinking, highly creative
C(harmonious): 语境句：We are making efforts to build a harmonious society. 固定搭配：harmonious relationship, live in a harmonious environment
D(simple): 语境句：He prefers a simple life in the countryside to a busy city life. 固定搭配：simple life, pure and simple

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。父亲是一个善良的人，他教导作者与周围人融洽相处的“价值/重要性(value)”。taught me the value of doing sth意为“教导我做某事的价值/意义”。mystery(谜)、definition(定义)、process(过程)均不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(mystery): 语境句：The origin of the universe remains a mystery to scientists. 固定搭配：solve a mystery, remain a mystery
B(value): 语境句：Volunteering helps teenagers realize the true value of helping others. 固定搭配：core value, value of life
C(definition): 语境句：By definition, a volunteer is someone who works without being paid. 固定搭配：by definition, clear definition
D(process): 语境句：Learning a foreign language is a slow and gradual process. 固定搭配：in the process of, learning process

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。根据后文的“Walking through... observing how people lived”可知，朋友邀请作者去“参观/走访(tour)”难民营。support(支持)、inspect(视察、检查)、invest(投资)均不符合作为普通访客的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(support): 语境句：We should support local businesses to boost the economy. 固定搭配：support oneself, in support of
B(inspect): 语境句：The official arrived to inspect the safety of the new building. 固定搭配：inspect closely, inspect the damage
C(invest): 语境句：The government decided to invest more money in public education. 固定搭配：invest in, invest time and energy
D(tour): 语境句：We hired a guide to tour the ancient city during the holiday. 固定搭配：tour a place, on tour

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。作者看到难民营里孩子们在泥土里玩耍，大人们眼神低垂，生活条件艰苦，因此内心感到“心碎的(heartbroken)”。helpless(无助的)、confused(困惑的)、troubled(苦恼的)情感深度不如heartbroken贴切，且heartbroken最能引出后文他想要提供帮助的决心。
questions.supplement:
A(helpless): 语境句：When the fire broke out, the villagers felt completely helpless. 固定搭配：feel helpless, helpless victim
B(confused): 语境句：I was a bit confused by the complicated instructions. 固定搭配：be confused about, look confused
C(troubled): 语境句：The troubled boy finally opened up to his psychology teacher. 固定搭配：troubled times, deeply troubled
D(heartbroken): 语境句：She was entirely heartbroken when her beloved pet passed away. 固定搭配：feel heartbroken, completely heartbroken

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。根据前文“eyes cast low(眼神低垂)”以及后文“as the sky was windy black(像狂风大作的黑天一样)”的隐喻，可知老年人们显得十分“沮丧的、抑郁的(depressed)”。bored(无聊的)、lonely(孤独的)、frightening(令人害怕的)均不符合此处沉重悲凉的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(bored): 语境句：The students got bored with the endless repetitive exercises. 固定搭配：be bored to death, get bored with
B(depressed): 语境句：He felt depressed after failing the important exam. 固定搭配：feel depressed, severely depressed
C(lonely): 语境句：Living alone in a foreign country, she often feels lonely. 固定搭配：feel lonely, a lonely journey
D(frightening): 语境句：It was a frightening experience to be trapped in the elevator. 固定搭配：frightening experience, frighteningly close

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。“flashed through my mind(在脑海中闪过)”通常搭配画面或影像。难民营白天见到的“画面/影像(images)”在夜晚如风般在作者脑海中不断闪现。thoughts(想法)、reflections(倒影/沉思)、shadows(影子)不如images具有画面感和视觉冲击力。
questions.supplement:
A(images): 语境句：Vivid images of his childhood flashed through his mind. 固定搭配：mental image, vivid images
B(thoughts): 语境句：She sat in silence, lost in her own deep thoughts. 固定搭配：lost in thought, second thoughts
C(reflections): 语境句：He looked at his own reflections in the calm water. 固定搭配：upon reflection, daily reflections
D(shadows): 语境句：The trees cast long shadows on the grass in the evening. 固定搭配：in the shadows, cast a shadow

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。作者的童年是充满和平与自由的(peace and freedom)，而难民营的家庭则生活在泥土和疲惫中，这两者之间形成了鲜明的“对比(contrast)”。connection(联系)、similarity(相似性)、unity(团结)均与语意相悖。
questions.supplement:
A(connection): 语境句：There is a close connection between diet and physical health. 固定搭配：make a connection, in connection with
B(similarity): 语境句：Despite their different backgrounds, there is a striking similarity between them. 固定搭配：bear a similarity to, striking similarity
C(contrast): 语境句：The sharp contrast between the rich and the poor was striking. 固定搭配：by contrast, sharp contrast
D(unity): 语境句：National unity is essential for the rapid development of a country. 固定搭配：in unity, sense of unity

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。这种鲜明的对比深深地“打动/触动(moved)”了作者，导致他内心产生一种冲动(a gentle pull in my heart)。pushed(推)、shaped(塑造)、burned(燃烧)不符合“触动内心”的表达习惯。
questions.supplement:
A(pushed): 语境句：The challenging environment pushed him to work even harder. 固定搭配：push forward, push sb to do sth
B(shaped): 语境句：His early experiences in the countryside shaped his character. 固定搭配：shape the future, shape one's character
C(burned): 语境句：The ancient building was burned to the ground last night. 固定搭配：burn down, burn out
D(moved): 语境句：We were deeply moved by his inspiring speech. 固定搭配：be deeply moved, move to tears

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。风曾经是穿过香蕉叶的顽皮低语，现在却承载着尘土飞扬的“绝望(desperation)”。结合前文难民的生活状态(疲惫、低垂的眼睛)，此处表达环境带给人的绝望感。guilt(内疚)、regret(后悔)、anger(愤怒)均不符合难民营整体展现出的低沉与无力感。
questions.supplement:
A(desperation): 语境句：In a moment of desperation, he sold his favorite car. 固定搭配：in desperation, feeling of desperation
B(guilt): 语境句：He was consumed by a deep sense of guilt for his mistake. 固定搭配：sense of guilt, admit guilt
C(regret): 语境句：Much to my regret, I couldn't attend her graduation ceremony. 固定搭配：express regret, much to one's regret
D(anger): 语境句：She tried hard to control her anger when facing the unfair treatment. 固定搭配：in anger, out of anger

questions.explanation: 本题考查副词辨析。内心的触动让作者的目标之种“真正地(truly)”扎了根。truly强调真实地、彻底地发生；suddenly(突然)、carefully(小心地)、constantly(不断地)均不贴切。这里强调内心的使命感变得坚定和确凿。
questions.supplement:
A(truly): 语境句：I am truly grateful for all the help you have given me. 固定搭配：yours truly, truly believe
B(suddenly): 语境句：The sky suddenly turned dark, and heavy rain poured down. 固定搭配：stop suddenly, suddenly realize
C(carefully): 语境句：Please read the instructions carefully before using the machine. 固定搭配：listen carefully, carefully designed
D(constantly): 语境句：The English language is constantly changing and evolving over time. 固定搭配：constantly change, constantly remind

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。目标扎根后，作者准备好去响应这种“召唤(call)”。answer the call是固定搭配，意为“响应号召，回应内心的呼唤”。challenge(挑战)、question(问题)、demand(要求)均不符合此处的语境搭配。
questions.supplement:
A(challenge): 语境句：Learning to play the piano was a huge challenge for him. 固定搭配：face a challenge, overcome a challenge
B(call): 语境句：Many young doctors answered the call to work in rural areas. 固定搭配：answer the call, a close call
C(question): 语境句：The reporter asked the president a very sharp question. 固定搭配：out of the question, beyond question
D(demand): 语境句：The workers' demand for higher pay was finally met. 固定搭配：meet the demand, in high demand

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。第二天作者回到难民营，开始在各个领域“做志愿服务(volunteering)”，结合后文“a whole team of dedicated volunteers”可知，他最初就是去当志愿者的。organizing(组织)、advocating(提倡)、evaluating(评估)不如volunteering贴合语境中的具体行动色彩。
questions.supplement:
A(organizing): 语境句：She is busy organizing a charity event to help disabled children. 固定搭配：organizing committee, organizing capacity
B(advocating): 语境句：The group is advocating for better environmental protection laws. 固定搭配：advocate for, strongly advocate
C(evaluating): 语境句：Teachers are evaluating the students' performance at the end of the term. 固定搭配：evaluate performance, evaluate the impact
D(volunteering): 语境句：Volunteering in the local hospital taught her the value of compassion. 固定搭配：volunteer to do sth, volunteer for

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。从作者一个人的努力，到五年内发展成一整个志愿者团队，这说明作者在慢慢“扩大(expanded)”他的努力/事业规模。adjusted(调整)、complicated(使复杂化)、varied(使多样化)均不能体现规模从小变大的过程。
questions.supplement:
A(adjusted): 语境句：He quickly adjusted his plan to suit the changing weather conditions. 固定搭配：adjust to, adjust one's strategy
B(complicated): 语境句：The sudden arrival of the guests complicated the whole situation. 固定搭配：complicated issue, highly complicated
C(expanded): 语境句：The small business expanded into a large international company. 固定搭配：expand the market, expand one's horizons
D(varied): 语境句：The school offers a varied program of cultural and sports activities. 固定搭配：varied interests, rich and varied

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。微小的目标“种子(seed)”经过五年时间，“成长为(grown into)”了一整个充满奉献精神的志愿者团队。符合比喻逻辑。broken into(破门而入/闯入)、transformed into(转变成，虽可通但grown与seed呼应更完美)、fallen into(养成/落入)。
questions.supplement:
A(grown into): 语境句：The small seed has grown into a magnificent oak tree. 固定搭配：grow into, grow up
B(broken into): 语境句：The house was broken into while the family was on vacation. 固定搭配：break into tears, break into a house
C(transformed into): 语境句：The old factory was transformed into a modern art museum. 固定搭配：transform A into B, completely transformed
D(fallen into): 语境句：He has fallen into the bad habit of staying up late. 固定搭配：fall into a habit, fall into sleep

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。后文提到“In unity, there is strength(团结就是力量)”，结合“together we stand(我们站在一起)”，可知他们是被一种信念“团结(united)”在一起。changed(改变)、influenced(影响)、comforted(安慰)均不能体现出团队的凝聚力。
questions.supplement:
A(changed): 语境句：Technology has changed the way we communicate with each other. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change for the better
B(influenced): 语境句：His writing style was deeply influenced by classical literature. 固定搭配：be influenced by, profoundly influenced
C(united): 语境句：The nation stood united in the face of the terrible natural disaster. 固定搭配：united as one, stay united
D(comforted): 语境句：The crying child was comforted by his mother's gentle voice. 固定搭配：feel comforted, be comforted by

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause (something) to become full of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“filled with”为过去分词短语，作伴随状语或定语，表示“充满……的”状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: The room fills with laughter when he tells a joke.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他讲笑话时，房间里充满了笑声。
vocab_pack.from_passage: life was simple, filled with peace and freedom

vocab_pack.definition_en: to coexist peacefully and agreeably with someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“living”为动名词形式，作介词with的宾语；整个短语作“the value of”的定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should learn to live in harmony with nature.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该学会与自然和谐共处。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the value of living in harmony with everyone around us

vocab_pack.definition_en: to ask someone politely to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“invited”为一般过去时，主语是“a friend”，宾语是“me”，不定式“to tour”为宾语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The school invited a famous scientist to give a lecture.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学校邀请了一位著名科学家来做讲座。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a friend invited me to tour Nakivale Refugee Settlement

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move on foot across or inside an area
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“walking”为现在分词，作时间状语，表示“在走过……的时候”。
vocab_pack.example_en: We walked through the forest and enjoyed the fresh air.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们步行穿过森林，享受了新鲜的空气。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Walking through the narrow, dusty paths

vocab_pack.definition_en: feeling extreme sadness or grief
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“heartbroken”为过去分词转化而来的形容词，作felt的表语，描述主语的情绪状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: She was heartbroken when she heard the news of her cat's death.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 听到她的猫去世的消息，她心碎了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I felt heartbroken observing how people lived

vocab_pack.definition_en: tired, especially after physical or mental effort
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“weary”为形容词，与“but full of laughter”并列，作独立主格结构中的补足语，描述孩子们的脸。
vocab_pack.example_en: After a long day's work, he felt weary and wanted to rest.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一整天的工作后，他感到疲惫，想要休息。
vocab_pack.from_passage: their faces weary but full of laughter

vocab_pack.definition_en: having a lot of something; containing a large amount
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“full of laughter”为形容词短语，与“weary”并列，补充说明“faces”的特征。
vocab_pack.example_en: The stadium was full of cheering fans.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 体育场里挤满了欢呼的粉丝。
vocab_pack.from_passage: their faces weary but full of laughter

vocab_pack.definition_en: to turn or direct (one's eyes) downward, often showing sadness or shame
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“cast low”为过去分词结构，与“their eyes”构成独立主格，表示“眼睛低垂着”。
vocab_pack.example_en: She cast her eyes low when she was criticized.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当被批评时，她低垂着眼睛。

vocab_pack.definition_en: sad and without hope; suffering from depression
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“depressed”为形容词，与“as...as”构成原级比较结构，意为“和……一样沮丧”。
vocab_pack.example_en: He felt depressed after failing the exam.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 考试失败后，他感到沮丧。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as depressed as the sky was windy black

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to compare two things that are equal in a certain quality
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“as depressed as”连接两个比较对象，形容词depressed置于第一个as之后，表示程度相等。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is as tall as her brother now.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她现在和她哥哥一样高了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as depressed as the sky was windy black

vocab_pack.definition_en: (of an idea or image) to come suddenly into one's mind
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“flashed”为一般过去时，主语是“images of the settlement”，表示这些画面突然出现在作者的脑海里。
vocab_pack.example_en: A brilliant idea flashed through his mind.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一个绝妙的主意闪过他的脑海。
vocab_pack.from_passage: images of the settlement flashed through my mind

vocab_pack.definition_en: a very clear and noticeable difference between two things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“sharp contrast”作主语，由定冠词the修饰，后接between...and...说明对比的双方。
vocab_pack.example_en: There is a sharp contrast between the rich and the poor in some cities.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在一些城市里，贫富之间存在鲜明对比。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The sharp contrast between my childhood and the life of families in Nakivale moved me deeply

vocab_pack.definition_en: to affect someone emotionally in a very strong way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“moved”为一般过去时，主语是“The sharp contrast”，宾语是“me”，副词“deeply”修饰动词。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her speech moved the audience deeply.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的演讲深深打动了观众。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to bear or be filled with (a heavy burden, meaning, or significance)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“carried”为一般过去时，主语是“The wind”，宾语是“the weight of dusty desperation”，表示风卷着灰尘和绝望。
vocab_pack.example_en: His words carried the weight of years of experience.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的话承载着多年经验的分量。
vocab_pack.from_passage: now carried the weight of dusty desperation

vocab_pack.definition_en: a state of feeling hopeless, often leading to extreme actions
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“desperation”为名词，作介词of的宾语，与dusty构成修饰关系，表示“布满灰尘的绝望”。
vocab_pack.example_en: In desperation, he decided to ask for help.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 绝望中，他决定寻求帮助。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a soft or subtle tug or attraction
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 轻微的拉扯；隐隐的吸引力
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“a gentle pull”作宾语，表示内心被轻轻牵动，是一种比喻用法。
vocab_pack.example_en: She felt a gentle pull towards helping the homeless.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她感到一种帮助无家可归者的隐隐召唤。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I felt a gentle pull in my heart

vocab_pack.definition_en: (of an idea, belief, or plant) to become established and begin to grow
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“had truly taken root”为过去完成时，表示“我的目的种子”在之前已经扎根成型。
vocab_pack.example_en: The idea of environmental protection has taken root in people's minds.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 环保理念已经在人们心中扎根。
vocab_pack.from_passage: My purpose seed had truly taken root

vocab_pack.definition_en: to respond to a summons or a strong inner urge to do something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 响应召唤；听从内心的呼唤
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“answer the call”为不定式短语，与“ready to”搭配，表示准备好回应内心使命的召唤。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many young people answered the call to join the army.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多年轻人响应号召参军。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was ready to answer the call

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go back to a place or situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“returned”为一般过去时，主语是“I”，宾语“to the settlement”表示方向。
vocab_pack.example_en: After graduation, she returned to her hometown to teach.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 毕业后，她回到家乡教书。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to begin an action (often a continuous activity)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“started”为一般过去时，后接动名词“volunteering”，表示开始从事志愿者工作。
vocab_pack.example_en: He started learning English at the age of six.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他六岁时开始学英语。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to offer to do something without being forced or paid
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“volunteering”为动名词，作started的宾语，表示从事志愿活动这一行为。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many students volunteer to help clean the park on weekends.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多学生周末志愿帮忙打扫公园。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to increase the scope or intensity of one's work or attempts
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 扩大努力范围；加大投入
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“expanded”为一般过去时，主语是“I”，宾语是“my efforts”，表示将自己的行动范围扩大。
vocab_pack.example_en: The charity expanded its efforts to reach more remote villages.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家慈善机构扩大了努力，以覆盖更多偏远村庄。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a small but strong inner sense of mission or life direction
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 使命的种子；人生目标的萌芽
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“a seed of purpose”作动词has的宾语，比喻每个人内心都有一颗等待发芽的目标种子。
vocab_pack.example_en: Every child has a seed of purpose that needs nurturing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每个孩子都有一颗需要培育的使命种子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: every person has a seed of purpose waiting to sprout

vocab_pack.definition_en: devoted to a task or purpose; willing to give a lot of time and effort
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 专注的；献身的；有奉献精神的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“dedicated”为形容词，修饰“volunteers”，描述他们是一群全心全意投入的志愿者。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is a dedicated teacher who always stays after class to help students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她是一位尽心尽责的老师，总是课后留下来帮助学生。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a whole team of dedicated volunteers

vocab_pack.definition_en: to remain together and in agreement, especially in a difficult situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“stand united”为系表结构，stand为系动词，united为形容词化的过去分词，表示“我们团结地站立”。
vocab_pack.example_en: We must stand united in the face of any challenge.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 面对任何挑战，我们必须团结一致。
vocab_pack.from_passage: together we stand, united by the belief

vocab_pack.definition_en: brought together and bonded by a common factor
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“united by”为过去分词短语，修饰主语we，表示我们被共同的信念团结起来。
vocab_pack.example_en: They were united by a shared love for music.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们因对音乐的共同热爱而团结在一起。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to delay action until a particular event or condition occurs
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“waiting”为现在分词，后接不定式“to sprout”，作定语修饰“a seed of purpose”，表示“等待发芽的种子”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The seedlings are waiting to be watered.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 幼苗正等着浇水。
vocab_pack.from_passage: every person has a seed of purpose waiting to sprout

vocab_pack.definition_en: (of a plant or idea) to begin to grow or develop
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“sprout”为不定式，与“waiting to”构成不定式短语，表示种子等待发芽。
vocab_pack.example_en: New leaves sprout from the branches in spring.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 春天，新叶从树枝上萌发出来。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a proverb meaning that people are stronger when they work together
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为倒装结构（地点状语in unity前置），正常语序为“There is strength in unity.”，是英语谚语。
vocab_pack.example_en: As the saying goes, there is strength in unity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 俗话说，团结就是力量。

vocab_pack.definition_en: infinite potential outcomes or opportunities
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中“endless possibilities”为省略结构，与“in hope”并列，完整句意为“在希望中，存在着无限可能”。
vocab_pack.example_en: With hard work and creativity, the future holds endless possibilities.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 通过努力和创造力，未来拥有无限可能。

section_2_word_form.passage:
Dishes in Chinese food culture have their origins. For example, “Dongpo Pork”. After Su Shi was downgraded, he came to Hangzhou organizing migrant workers to dredge(疏浚) the West Lake, build bridges, [56] transform the old West Lake into a new look. People there were very grateful to Su Shi for [57] he had done. It was heard that he liked pork best, so everyone would carry meat and wine to him to pay a New Year greeting. After [58] (receive) it, Su Shi instructed his family to cut the meat into cubes, burned it red and crisp, and then [59] (distribute) it to the migrant workers participating in the dredging of the West Lake to eat. People warmly called the meat “Dongpo Pork” because of Su Shi's name.
In the West, there's also a story behind the origin of food. For example, pizza and the story of Queen Margherita. Thin, round bread [60] (use) in the cooking of Egyptians, Etruscans and Romans long ago. It was eaten at the end of every meal during the Renaissance [61] a dish for the poor and enriched by the arrival of various [62] (tomato) from America in the 18th century: it was then that it began to gain the appreciation of the [63] (wealth) classes. Another important date in the pizza story is 1899 when Queen Margherita of Savoy made the famous Neapolitan pizza maker Raffaele Esposito [64] (prepare) a pizza in three colors, symbolizing the Italian flag. The Pizza was named “Pizza Margherita”. Since then, pizza [65] (take) the world by storm.

questions.explanation: 本题考查连词。分析句子结构，dredge, build和transform三个动词原形作宾语补足语，属于平行并列结构（organize sb to do A, do B, and do C），因此在最后一个动词前需要填并列连词and。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：He enjoys reading books, listening to music, and playing basketball. 固定搭配：both... and..., and so on。相关考点：在列举多个并列成分时，最后两个成分之间用and连接，前面共用to。

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词性从句。介词for后接宾语从句。在从句“_ he had done”中，done缺少宾语，且表示“他所做的事情”，故填入what引导该宾语从句并在从句中作宾语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(what)：语境句：I am totally responsible for what I have said. 固定搭配：what to do, what's more。相关考点：what在名词性从句中必须充当主语、宾语或表语，相当于the thing(s) that。

questions.explanation: 本题考查非谓语动词。After在此处作介词，后接动词时需使用动名词(V-ing)形式作介词的宾语，且主语Su Shi与receive是主动关系，故填receiving。
questions.supplement: 正确形(receiving)：语境句：After receiving the letter, she immediately burst into tears. 固定搭配：look forward to receiving, upon receiving。原词receive其它变形：receiver(n. 接收者/听筒), receipt(n. 收据/收到)。

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词时态与并列结构。此处与前面的instructed和burned构成连续动作的并列谓语，句子整体是一般过去时，因此填动词过去式distributed。
questions.supplement: 正确形(distributed)：语境句：The charity distributed food and clothes to the earthquake victims. 固定搭配：distribute to, widely distributed。原词distribute其它变形：distribution(n. 分发/分布), distributor(n. 经销商)。

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词的时态和语态。主语Thin, round bread与use之间是被动关系（面包被使用）；时间状语是long ago，表示发生在过去的事情，故用一般过去时的被动语态。bread为不可数名词，谓语动词用单数，填was used。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was used)：语境句：This ancient tool was used for hunting thousands of years ago. 固定搭配：be used for doing sth, be used to do sth。原词use其它变形：useful(adj. 有用的), useless(adj. 无用的), usage(n. 使用/用法)。

questions.explanation: 本题考查介词。be eaten as...意为“作为……被吃”。as此处作介词，意为“作为”，符合句意“在文艺复兴时期它作为穷人的菜肴被食用”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(as)：语境句：He worked as an assistant manager for three years. 固定搭配：act as, serve as, regard... as。相关考点：as作介词常表示身份、用途或角色。

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词复数。根据前面的various (各种各样的)可知，此处需用名词复数形式。tomato以o结尾，其复数形式一般加-es，故填tomatoes。
questions.supplement: 正确形(tomatoes)：语境句：The farmer harvested a large basket of fresh tomatoes. 固定搭配：cherry tomatoes, tomato paste。相关考点：以o结尾加es的常见名词有：hero, potato, tomato, Negro (口诀：黑人英雄爱吃土豆西红柿)。

questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换。空处修饰名词classes(阶级)，需用形容词形式。wealth是名词，其形容词形式为wealthy(富有的)。
questions.supplement: 正确形(wealthy)：语境句：The wealthy businessman donated a lot of money to the local school. 固定搭配：wealthy family, the wealthy (富人)。原词wealth其它变形：wealth(n. 财富), wealthily(adv. 富有地)。

questions.explanation: 本题考查非谓语动词。此处是make sb. do sth.结构，即使役动词make后跟不带to的不定式作宾语补足语，故填动词原形prepare。
questions.supplement: 正确形(prepare)：语境句：The teacher made the students prepare for the upcoming debate. 固定搭配：make sb do sth, prepare for, prepare to do。原词prepare其它变形：preparation(n. 准备), prepared(adj. 准备好的)。

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词时态。句首有时间状语Since then (从那时起)，它通常与现在完成时连用。主语pizza是单数，故填has taken。take the world by storm是固定表达，意为“风靡世界”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(has taken)：语境句：Since its release, the new video game has taken the market by storm. 固定搭配：take... by storm, take action。原词take其它变形：took(过去式), taken(过去分词), taking(现在分词)。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the starting point or cause of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中出现复数形式 origins，表示多种菜肴的起源；学习时掌握原型 origin。
vocab_pack.example_en: The origin of the festival is still unknown.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个节日的起源仍然未知。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to arrange or plan an activity or event
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中为现在分词 organizing，与主语 Su Shi 构成主动关系，作伴随状语；原形 organize。
vocab_pack.example_en: She organized the fundraising event last week.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她上周组织了筹款活动。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to remove mud or debris from a river, lake, etc., to make it deeper or cleaner
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中为不定式 to dredge 中的动词原形，表示目的；原形 dredge。
vocab_pack.example_en: They plan to dredge the river to improve navigation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们计划疏浚河道以改善通航。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to construct something by putting parts together
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中为不定式 to build 中的动词原形，与 dredge 并列作目的状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: They will build a new school in the village.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们将在村庄里建一所新学校。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to change something completely into something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中 transform 为不定式（与 to dredge 并列），动词原形，表示目的；搭配 into 表示改变的结果。
vocab_pack.example_en: The old factory was transformed into a modern art gallery.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 旧工厂被改造成了一个现代美术馆。
vocab_pack.from_passage: transform the old West Lake into a new look

vocab_pack.definition_en: feeling or showing thanks to someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中作表语（were grateful），后接 to sb for sth 结构；原形 grateful。
vocab_pack.example_en: I am very grateful for your help.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我非常感激你的帮助。
vocab_pack.from_passage: were very grateful to Su Shi

vocab_pack.definition_en: to hold something and take it somewhere
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中用于 would 后，动词原形，表示过去经常发生的行为；原形 carry。
vocab_pack.example_en: She always carries a book in her bag.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她总是在包里带一本书。
vocab_pack.from_passage: carry meat and wine to him

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give a greeting or make a polite visit
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中为不定式目的状语（to pay a New Year greeting），pay 是动词原形；'pay a greeting' 是固定搭配，'New Year' 修饰 greeting。
vocab_pack.example_en: We went to pay our greetings to the elders during the festival.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 节日期间我们去向长辈拜年。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to pay a New Year greeting

vocab_pack.definition_en: to get or be given something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中为现在分词 receiving，作时间状语 'After receiving it' 中的介词 after 后接动名词，表示主动动作；原形 receive。
vocab_pack.example_en: He received a letter from his friend yesterday.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他昨天收到了朋友的一封信。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to tell someone to do something officially or formally
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中为过去式 instructed，后接宾语 his family 和不定式 to cut；主语 Su Shi，主动语态。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher instructed the students to complete the assignment.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师指示学生完成作业。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to divide something into smaller pieces using a knife or tool
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中 cut 为不定式（to cut）中的动词原形，后接宾语 the meat 和 into cubes；表示切割后的状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: She cut the cake into eight pieces.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她把蛋糕切成八块。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause something to be damaged or destroyed by fire; to cook something with strong heat
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中 burned 为过去式，与 instructed 并列，表示连续动作；动词原形 burn。
vocab_pack.example_en: She burned the toast by leaving it in the oven too long.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她把吐司放在烤箱里太久，烤焦了。

vocab_pack.definition_en: firm, dry, and easily broken; pleasantly hard or crunchy
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中作宾语补足语，形容烧制后肉的状态（burned it red and crisp），crisp 为形容词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: The apple was fresh and crisp.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那个苹果新鲜又脆。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give something out to several people
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中 distributed 为过去式，与 burned 并列，后接 it (the meat) to the migrant workers；主动语态。
vocab_pack.example_en: The charity distributed food to the homeless.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 慈善机构向无家可归者分发了食物。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take part in an activity or event
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中为现在分词短语 participating in 作后置定语修饰 migrant workers，表示主动参与；原形 participate in。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many students participate in extracurricular activities.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多学生参加课外活动。

vocab_pack.definition_en: with kindness, enthusiasm, or affection
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中修饰动词 called，作状语，表示方式；副词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: They welcomed the guests warmly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们热情地欢迎了客人。

vocab_pack.definition_en: as a result of; on account of
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中接名词短语 Su Shi's name，表示原因；固定介词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The flight was delayed because of bad weather.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 航班因为恶劣天气延误了。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to employ something for a purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中 was used 为一般过去时的被动语态，主语 thin, round bread，used 为过去分词；原形 use。
vocab_pack.example_en: This tool is used to cut wood.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个工具是用来切割木头的。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take food into the mouth and swallow it
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中 was eaten 为一般过去时的被动语态，过去分词 eaten；原形 eat。
vocab_pack.example_en: The cake was eaten by the children.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 蛋糕被孩子们吃了。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a particular type of food prepared for eating
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中作单数名词，as a dish for the poor；原形 dish。
vocab_pack.example_en: This dish is very popular in the region.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这道菜在该地区很受欢迎。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as a dish for the poor

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make something richer or better in quality
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中 enriched 为过去分词短语作状语，表示面包被西红柿的到来所丰富，被动意义；原形 enrich。
vocab_pack.example_en: Reading books enriches your knowledge.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 阅读书籍丰富你的知识。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act of coming to a place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中为单数名词，与 the 连用，后接 of 短语；原形 arrival。
vocab_pack.example_en: The arrival of spring brings new life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 春天的到来带来了新生。

vocab_pack.definition_en: different from each other; of several kinds
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中修饰复数名词 tomatoes，作定语；形容词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: The store sells various kinds of fruits.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家商店出售各种水果。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to receive or achieve admiration or understanding from others
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中 gain 为不定式（began to gain）中的动词原形，后接宾语 the appreciation；appreciation 为不可数名词，前面有定冠词 the 限定。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her hard work gained the appreciation of her boss.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的努力获得了老板的赏识。
vocab_pack.from_passage: gain the appreciation of the wealthy classes

vocab_pack.definition_en: having a lot of money or property; rich
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中修饰复数名词 classes，作定语；形容词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: The wealthy businessman donated a large sum to charity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那位富有的商人向慈善机构捐了一大笔钱。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause or force someone to perform an action
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中 made 为过去式，后接宾语 the famous Neapolitan pizza maker Raffaele Esposito 和不带 to 的动词原形 prepare；主动语态。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher made the students rewrite the essay.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师让学生重写作文。
vocab_pack.from_passage: made the famous Neapolitan pizza maker ... prepare

vocab_pack.definition_en: to represent or stand for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中为现在分词短语 symbolizing the Italian flag 作定语修饰 a pizza，表示主动含义（pizza 象征国旗）；原形 symbolize。
vocab_pack.example_en: The dove symbolizes peace.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鸽子象征和平。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give a name to someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中 was named 为一般过去时的被动语态，named 为过去分词；后接名称 'Pizza Margherita'。
vocab_pack.example_en: The baby was named after his grandfather.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个婴儿以他祖父的名字命名。

vocab_pack.definition_en: from that time until now
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中作时间状语，位于句首，与现在完成时 has taken 连用，表示从过去某一时间点持续到现在。
vocab_pack.example_en: Since then, they have lived happily.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 从那时起，他们幸福地生活着。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Since then, pizza has taken the world by storm.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become extremely popular or successful very quickly
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 迅速风靡世界；大获成功
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中为现在完成时 has taken，taken 为过去分词；固定习语，比喻像风暴一样席卷全球。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new app took the world by storm within weeks.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这款新应用在几周内风靡全球。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has taken the world by storm
